# netskope_aig_token_group (Resource)

Manages an AI Gateway token group. Token groups are named collections of API tokens used in rate limit rule criteria to identify and throttle specific client applications or users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_aig_token_group" "my_aigtokengroup" {
  description = "Tokens for the IT department ChatBot"
  name        = "IT ChatBot"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name for the token group (1–100 characters).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the token group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the token group.
- `token_count` (Number) Number of tokens in this group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netskope_aig_token_group.my_netskope_aig_token_group
  id = "019812aa-bdba-7a48-baa2-2de8c6006fda"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskope_aig_token_group.my_netskope_aig_token_group "019812aa-bdba-7a48-baa2-2de8c6006fda"
```
